description: This Java class 'EncryptedDocument' handles encryption, decryption, and authentication of a single encrypted document stored on disk. It manages reading and writing encrypted metadata and content sections, using AES-CTR encryption and SHA-256 MAC, with support for atomic file updates.

classes.name: EncryptedDocument
classes.description: Class managing encrypted storage of a document, including reading/writing encrypted metadata and content, with MAC validation and atomic file updates.

classes.name: EncryptedDocument.Section
classes.description: Inner class representing the header of a file section, including length, IV, and MAC, with methods for reading, writing, and MAC validation.

methods.name: EncryptedDocument
methods.description: Constructor initializing encryption parameters and keys.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the file associated with this encrypted document.

methods.name: readMetadata
methods.description: Reads and decrypts the metadata section, validating document ID.

methods.name: readContent
methods.description: Reads and decrypts the content section, writing to provided output pipe.

methods.name: writeMetadataAndContent
methods.description: Encrypts and writes metadata and content sections atomically, reading content from input pipe.

methods.name: readSection
methods.description: Reads and decrypts a section starting at current file pointer, validating MAC.

methods.name: writeSection
methods.description: Encrypts and writes a data stream as a section, updating header with length and MAC.

methods.name: assertMagic
methods.description: Validates the magic number at start of file.
